purpose: Build, flash, read back, and inspect the tethered integrated IMU/ToF/PMW3901 control image with physical motor output enabled.
status: Integrated control image is installed and boots. Physical output is enabled but idle at zero PWM. No takeoff or flight acceptance was performed.

control_paths.imu: Attitude and rate loop runs throughout powered flight.
control_paths.tof: Fused vertical observation and height loop run when ToF range is valid; 5-39 mm near-ground samples remain outside the valid-height policy.
control_paths.pmw3901: Relative XY position outer loop and optical-flow velocity inner loop are compiled into the active profile and fade in at 80 mm usable range; IMU attitude control remains active.
control_paths.flow_calibration: Provisional signed axes forward=+dy/right=+dx and nominal scale 0.002131946 rad/count; FLOW_CALIBRATED and CL_FLOW_AXES_VERIFIED remain 0. This is active tethered trial control, not accepted calibration or stable-flight proof.

software_validation.result: PASS: host control, PWM, flow, recovery, and safety tests; 12 PlatformIO firmware environments; active profile markers and physical PWM driver symbol checked.

boot_capture.tof: present; raw distance 5-27 mm and valid=0 on the table, below the 40 mm valid-height policy

earlier_boot_issue: The first active-flow image booted with I2C2 BUSY after a debug reset, leaving IMU/ToF unavailable. I2C2_ClearBusAtBoot was added before peripheral initialization; this image reports boot_bus_clear=0, calibrated IMU, ToF present, and flow present.
flight_acceptance: Pending. Current boot capture has radio link=0. The board has not received a takeoff command in this validation, and no physical motor or flight response is claimed.
